question.text: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

exchange.sent: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

answer.answer:
The passages do not rank “most important” signal integrity capabilities for Wireless Communication, but they support the following priority set by combining the Wireless Communication application context with the documented SI / PCB capability lists [11][48][4][38].
| Capability | Why it matters for Wireless Communication applications | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Insertion Loss / IL measurement | Wireless Communication sources cover RF, 5G, Wi‑Fi, mmWave and LEO satellite RF validation contexts, while the SI flow lists IL as a core high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity item [11][48][4]. | [11][48][4] |
| Crosstalk / Xtalk analysis | The SI flow explicitly lists Xtalk with IL and Eye diagram as part of high-speed PCB/PCBA signal integrity flow [4][5]. | [4][5] |
| Eye diagram analysis | The SI flow explicitly lists Eye diagram with IL and Xtalk for high-speed PCB/PCBA signal integrity flow, and R&S PCB test solutions also list Eye diagram under material / stackup selection [4][38]. | [4][38] |
| TDR impedance measurement | The SI flow lists TDR Impedance, and R&S PCB test solutions list Material Measurement with Impedance by TDR plus later impedance checks in stackup selection, SI modeling/testing and sampling testing [4][38]. | [4][38] |
| Dk / Df extraction and material characterization | R&S PCB test solutions list DK/DF extraction in Material Measurement and DK/DF in material / stackup selection, SI modeling/testing and sampling testing [38]. | [38] |
| Surface roughness evaluation | R&S PCB test solutions list roughness in material / stackup selection and signal integrity modeling/testing [38]. | [38] |
| Transmission-line modeling / TL Calculator | The SI flow lists TL Calculator, and R&S PCB test solutions list TL modeling in material / stackup selection [4][38]. | [4][38] |
| Stackup planning / material-stackup selection | The SI flow lists Stackup Planner, and R&S PCB test solutions include Material/Stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling and Eye diagram [4][38]. | [4][38] |
| Sampling testing and process monitoring of IL / Dk-Df / impedance | R&S PCB test solutions list Sampling testing with IL, DK/DF and impedance, and PL / Process Monitoring in the same flow context [38]. | [38] |
【推論】For Wireless Communication hardware that includes 5G, Wi‑Fi, mmWave, LEO satellite terminals, phased-array beamforming, mmWave and MIMO high-frequency testing, the most defensible SI focus areas from the passages are channel loss, impedance control, material Dk/Df, crosstalk, eye quality, transmission-line/stackup modeling, and production monitoring, because those wireless application areas are stated separately from the SI capability flow and PCB test solution items [11][48][9][4][38].

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 Loss tangent（Df）或 Dissipation Factor 是 signal 沿 transmission line 傳播時 signal attenuation 的量測。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 dielectric loss 來自 dielectric material 對 electromagnetic wave 的吸收；frequency 增加時，dielectric loss 也成比例增加。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 ultra-low loss materials 的 Df 通常範圍為 0.02 到 0.001；較小的 Df 會造成較低 signal attenuation；[[PCIe]] 等 high speed applications 需要低 Df。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 [[fiberglass weave]] 的 εr 約為 6，[[epoxy]] 的 εr 約為 3；fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 Df 差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 通常範圍為 2.5 到 4.5，並隨 frequency 變化；frequency 增加時 εr 下降。

answer.text:
The passages do not rank “most important” signal integrity capabilities for Wireless Communication, but they support the following priority set by combining the Wireless Communication application context with the documented SI / PCB capability lists [11][48][4][38].
| Capability | Why it matters for Wireless Communication applications | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Insertion Loss / IL measurement | Wireless Communication sources cover RF, 5G, Wi‑Fi, mmWave and LEO satellite RF validation contexts, while the SI flow lists IL as a core high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity item [11][48][4]. | [11][48][4] |
| Crosstalk / Xtalk analysis | The SI flow explicitly lists Xtalk with IL and Eye diagram as part of high-speed PCB/PCBA signal integrity flow [4][5]. | [4][5] |
| Eye diagram analysis | The SI flow explicitly lists Eye diagram with IL and Xtalk for high-speed PCB/PCBA signal integrity flow, and R&S PCB test solutions also list Eye diagram under material / stackup selection [4][38]. | [4][38] |
| TDR impedance measurement | The SI flow lists TDR Impedance, and R&S PCB test solutions list Material Measurement with Impedance by TDR plus later impedance checks in stackup selection, SI modeling/testing and sampling testing [4][38]. | [4][38] |
| Dk / Df extraction and material characterization | R&S PCB test solutions list DK/DF extraction in Material Measurement and DK/DF in material / stackup selection, SI modeling/testing and sampling testing [38]. | [38] |
| Surface roughness evaluation | R&S PCB test solutions list roughness in material / stackup selection and signal integrity modeling/testing [38]. | [38] |
| Transmission-line modeling / TL Calculator | The SI flow lists TL Calculator, and R&S PCB test solutions list TL modeling in material / stackup selection [4][38]. | [4][38] |
| Stackup planning / material-stackup selection | The SI flow lists Stackup Planner, and R&S PCB test solutions include Material/Stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling and Eye diagram [4][38]. | [4][38] |
| Sampling testing and process monitoring of IL / Dk-Df / impedance | R&S PCB test solutions list Sampling testing with IL, DK/DF and impedance, and PL / Process Monitoring in the same flow context [38]. | [38] |
【推論】For Wireless Communication hardware that includes 5G, Wi‑Fi, mmWave, LEO satellite terminals, phased-array beamforming, mmWave and MIMO high-frequency testing, the most defensible SI focus areas from the passages are channel loss, impedance control, material Dk/Df, crosstalk, eye quality, transmission-line/stackup modeling, and production monitoring, because those wireless application areas are stated separately from the SI capability flow and PCB test solution items [11][48][9][4][38].

無線通訊認證實驗室 › 重點摘要
本來源是由 `無線通訊認證實驗室.pptx` 轉出的 company restricted 簡報，正式發布日期與文件版次未標示；raw frontmatter 顯示 converted 日期為 2026-09-17。

來源將[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]定義為測試與驗證無線設備符合法規、安全與性能標準的實驗室，涵蓋 [[RF 測試]]、[[EMC]]、安規與一致性認證，並稱其可支援 [[Global Market Access]]（GMA）與加速上市。

主要內容包括：

- 無線設備認證實驗室涵蓋 RF、EMC、安規與一致性認證。
- 主要測試項目包含頻譜、輸出功率、[[DFS]]、[[SAR]]、EMI / EMS、靜電放電、電源突波、[[Protocol 相容性]]、互操作性測試與 [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] 認證。
- 來源稱認證必要性包括防止電磁干擾與頻譜衝突、保障用戶安全、加速上市、降低召回與法律風險，以及滿足台灣供應鏈衛星終端與 6G 等需求。
- 來源列出台灣 [[NCC]] 認證流程：準備文件 / 樣品 / 電路圖 / 天線規格、提交 [[RCB]] 核驗機構初審、[[TAF]] 認可實驗室 RF / EMC 測試約 3–4 週、報告審查與證書核發，並稱證書有效期 5 年。
- 來源列出台灣領先認證實驗室：[[耕興]]、[[SGS]]、[[電信技術中心]] / [[ISL]]。
- 來源稱[[耕興]]具 30 MHz–325 GHz 全頻段測試能力、108 座測試場地、連續 10 年 FCC 最佳實驗室認證、10 米半電波暗室、OTA / SAR / [[相控陣列天線]]測試等能力。
- 來源簡述 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]、[[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]、Wi‑Fi / BLE 聯盟流程的差異。
- 來源將 LEO 衛星終端認證應用連到 Starlink / Kuiper user terminal RF validation、[[相控陣列天線]] beamforming 測試、mmWave / MIMO 高頻測試、台灣供應鏈 GMA，以及耕興等 [[RCB]] 提供 8–12 週 GMA 週期的說法。

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 Loss tangent（Df）或 Dissipation Factor 是 signal 沿 transmission line 傳播時 signal attenuation 的量測。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 dielectric loss 來自 dielectric material 對 electromagnetic wave 的吸收；frequency 增加時，dielectric loss 也成比例增加。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 ultra-low loss materials 的 Df 通常範圍為 0.02 到 0.001；較小的 Df 會造成較低 signal attenuation；[[PCIe]] 等 high speed applications 需要低 Df。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 [[fiberglass weave]] 的 εr 約為 6，[[epoxy]] 的 εr 約為 3；fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 Df 差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 通常範圍為 2.5 到 4.5，並隨 frequency 變化；frequency 增加時 εr 下降。

answer.text:
The passages do not rank “most important” signal integrity capabilities for Wireless Communication, but they support the following priority set by combining the Wireless Communication application context with the documented SI / PCB capability lists [11][48][4][38].
| Capability | Why it matters for Wireless Communication applications | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Insertion Loss / IL measurement | Wireless Communication sources cover RF, 5G, Wi‑Fi, mmWave and LEO satellite RF validation contexts, while the SI flow lists IL as a core high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity item [11][48][4]. | [11][48][4] |
| Crosstalk / Xtalk analysis | The SI flow explicitly lists Xtalk with IL and Eye diagram as part of high-speed PCB/PCBA signal integrity flow [4][5]. | [4][5] |
| Eye diagram analysis | The SI flow explicitly lists Eye diagram with IL and Xtalk for high-speed PCB/PCBA signal integrity flow, and R&S PCB test solutions also list Eye diagram under material / stackup selection [4][38]. | [4][38] |
| TDR impedance measurement | The SI flow lists TDR Impedance, and R&S PCB test solutions list Material Measurement with Impedance by TDR plus later impedance checks in stackup selection, SI modeling/testing and sampling testing [4][38]. | [4][38] |
| Dk / Df extraction and material characterization | R&S PCB test solutions list DK/DF extraction in Material Measurement and DK/DF in material / stackup selection, SI modeling/testing and sampling testing [38]. | [38] |
| Surface roughness evaluation | R&S PCB test solutions list roughness in material / stackup selection and signal integrity modeling/testing [38]. | [38] |
| Transmission-line modeling / TL Calculator | The SI flow lists TL Calculator, and R&S PCB test solutions list TL modeling in material / stackup selection [4][38]. | [4][38] |
| Stackup planning / material-stackup selection | The SI flow lists Stackup Planner, and R&S PCB test solutions include Material/Stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling and Eye diagram [4][38]. | [4][38] |
| Sampling testing and process monitoring of IL / Dk-Df / impedance | R&S PCB test solutions list Sampling testing with IL, DK/DF and impedance, and PL / Process Monitoring in the same flow context [38]. | [38] |
【推論】For Wireless Communication hardware that includes 5G, Wi‑Fi, mmWave, LEO satellite terminals, phased-array beamforming, mmWave and MIMO high-frequency testing, the most defensible SI focus areas from the passages are channel loss, impedance control, material Dk/Df, crosstalk, eye quality, transmission-line/stackup modeling, and production monitoring, because those wireless application areas are stated separately from the SI capability flow and PCB test solution items [11][48][9][4][38].
